📌 Liverpool vs Atletico Madrid match preview: team news, injuries, predicted lineups and how to watch Wednesday’s Champions League clash at Anfield.

Liverpool begin their 2026–27 Champions League campaign at Anfield on Wednesday when Atlético Madrid arrive for the opening league-phase fixture. The meeting immediately brings back memories of last season’s dramatic clash on Merseyside, when Liverpool scored twice inside the opening six minutes before Atlético fought back to level the contest. Virgil van Dijk eventually settled the match with a stoppage-time header to give the Reds a 3-2 victory. This time, however, Liverpool have a Champions League debutant in the dugout. Andoni Iraola will oversee his first European match as Liverpool manager after securing his first victory in charge with a 2-0 win at Ipswich Town. Atlético arrive in contrasting form after Athletic Club handed Diego Simeone’s side a 3-0 defeat at San Mamés.
​
Liverpool will host Atlético Madrid at Anfield in the Champions League league phase on Wednesday, September 9.
​
Liverpool head into their Champions League opener with several players unavailable. Wataru Endō and Federico Chiesa were left off the club’s Champions League roster and therefore cannot feature against Atlético Madrid.
​
The injury list also includes Hugo Ekitiké, Conor Bradley and Giovanni Leoni, who have all been ruled out. Joe Gomez is dealing with a muscle issue and faces a late fitness test.
​
Andoni Iraola also has a decision to make over Bradley Barcola. The £100m signing made his Liverpool debut as a second-half substitute against Ipswich and has been described by the manager as ready to play more minutes. That could lead to his first start for the club.
​
Alexander Isak is another major talking point after scoring twice inside the opening 10 minutes at Ipswich. The striker will be looking to score in three consecutive Liverpool matches for the first time.
​
Ronald Araújo is also expected to retain his place at right back after an impressive display at Portman Road.
​
Atlético Madrid arrive at Anfield after suffering their first defeat of the season, with Athletic Club winning 3-0 at San Mamés.
​
Alexander Sørloth is expected to miss the match with a thigh injury, reducing Simeone’s attacking options. Arnau Ortiz is also unavailable after suspension.
​
Julián Alvarez could return to the starting lineup after being gradually reintroduced following his summer transfer saga and recent illness. The Argentine came off the bench against Athletic but could now be brought back into the XI.
​
Cristian Romero could also make his first start at centre-back, potentially replacing Dávid Hancko. Meanwhile, Jonathan David could make his Atlético debut after joining on loan from Juventus, although he is expected to begin on the bench.
​
Liverpool's first victory under Iraola came at an important moment after the team's opening two matches ended in 2-2 draws against Newcastle and Nottingham Forest.
​
The Liverpool manager highlighted the importance of the clean sheet in the 2-0 victory at Ipswich.
​
Iraola has also indicated that Barcola is ready to handle more minutes after his debut, strengthening the possibility of the new signing starting against Atlético.
​
Diego Simeone was left frustrated by Atlético's performance in the second half of their defeat at Athletic Club.
